keySentence: Three ghosts showed him the truth.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The second ghost showed the present. Bob's family was poor but happy. The third ghost showed the future. Three ghosts showed him the truth.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Ghost of Christmas Present showed Scrooge the world today. He saw Bob's poor family sharing a tiny Christmas dinner. Little Tim was sick but still smiled and thanked God for everything. Three ghosts showed him the truth about his cold, lonely life. The Ghost of Christmas Future showed Scrooge his own grave. No one cared that he had died because he had loved no one.
